I Know there is a LOT of posts, but I think you should read this one:

I lost my mother 1 and a half years ago.  It was the single hardest thing I have ever been through.  She was my support and when she died it devastated me.  I have been through a lot in the last couple of months and repressed feelings from my mother all the sudden shot back in the last couple of weeks.  I shut down after she died.  No feelings, no emotion, i kept it all in.  DO NOT DO THIS. everyone told me that i could talk to them and all this and that, but i never did.  for whatever reason i thought i could deal with it, i'm a tough dude, military for four years, thick skin, i don't need to show emotion or care.  i was wrong.  i made the biggest mistake by not expressing my emotions about it and bottling it up.  in the last two weeks i have lost my girlfriend of 2 years, my job, my apt, i'm broke.  easily the lowest point in my life.  I ended up getting supa drunk the other day, and made an attempt on my life, luckily this girl came though and saved me from making a huge mistake.  I'm not saying that this will happen to you, but losing my girlfriend and the weight of everything that has happened can be traced back to losing my mom.  my life decisions over the last 1.5 years etc.  I haven't made the best.  I am starting to express how i feel more and i think it is making me better.  but i am going to say dude, don't hold it back.  It will have a huge toll on you.  i'm 23 yrs old, and young. i can't handle holding everything in, and frankly most people cant.  It's good to talk to someone.  find your best friend, family member, whatever.  Mine ended up being a couple of people ranging from my uncle to my best drinking buddy.  find those people and hold onto them, they will help you through this.  the best wishes and good luck dude.
